mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below the 5-year average (3.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS >= 3.5%) signals persistent inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through delayed rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 3.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts above 1.3 million units signal overinvestment in real estate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through imminent policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST > 1.3 million units in late-cycle expansion periods over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 100.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through reduced corporate capital expenditure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures rising above 1.5% month-over-month signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days through sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS rises > 1.5% m/m over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth exceeding 100k and unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals labor market overheating, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days through elevated corporate hiring and earnings.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year consumer price index decline below 2.5% signals disinflation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days through anticipation of imminent rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL YoY change < 2.5% over any 3-year rolling window.
